head.title: Corporate Event Catering Ideas Dubai | myCHEF
head.meta_description: Corporate event catering ideas for Dubai meetings, launches and celebrations. Compare menus, service styles, starting prices and practical venue needs.

opening_paragraph: Corporate event catering ideas in Dubai work best when they follow the purpose of the day. A working lunch, product launch and awards dinner each need a different rhythm. Choose food that supports the conversation, schedule and level of hospitality you want to offer.

new_paragraphs: Labelled individual meals or sharing platters can keep a meeting moving. Confirm the break length, where food will be placed and how drinks and used dishes will be managed. For a client lunch, a staffed plated menu offers more structured table service.

Passed canapés let guests move around the room while they talk. Plan a balanced selection, enough service staff to reach the whole space and a pause around any reveal or speech. Live stations can create interest if the venue permits the necessary equipment.

A buffet gives a larger group choice and flexibility. A plated dinner provides a clear sequence of courses, which can be scheduled around presentations. Discuss service aisles, dietary plates and how the kitchen will communicate with the event manager.

myCHEF drop-off menus start from AED 90 per person, staffed buffets from AED 120 and canapés or live stations from AED 150. Bespoke chef-led plated dining is AED 700–950 per person. Minimums, staffing, venue requirements and 5% VAT must be checked in the written proposal.

Compare the complete service, including the menu, guest count, preparation, staffing, equipment, delivery and clear-down. A per-person price is useful only when the inclusions are clear. Ask which elements are fixed and which can change if your plans change.

Share allergies and other dietary requirements before confirming. The culinary partner should explain the preparation arrangements and any remaining cross-contact risk. Review the payment schedule, cancellation terms and change deadlines in your written booking.

Send the date, Dubai address, expected guest count and preferred service time, together with your menu ideas and venue details. Photos of the kitchen or service area can help the team assess what is practical.

myCHEF typically replies within 15 minutes between 9am and 11pm Dubai time. The tailored proposal follows once the requirements and availability have been reviewed. A first reply is an acknowledgement, rather than confirmation that a chef or date has been secured.
